description: Synthetische DE-Kapitelbehauptung / EN-Quellkontext-Paare zur Pruefung, ob ein lokales NLI-Modell als Batch-Vorfilter fuer Zitat-Treue taugt (Issue #524). ACHTUNG: konstruierte Faelle, keine echten Zitate aus einer Abschlussarbeit.

cases.chapter_claim: Laut Braun und Clarke (2006) durchlaeuft die thematische Analyse sechs aufeinanderfolgende Phasen, von der Vertrautheit mit den Daten bis zur Verfassung des Berichts.
cases.context_before: In this paper we outline a method for conducting qualitative analysis.
cases.verbatim: We outline a six-phase approach to thematic analysis, beginning with familiarising yourself with your data and ending with producing the report.
cases.context_after: Each phase is iterative rather than strictly linear.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Die Autoren betonen, dass qualitative Forschung kein Defizitmodell quantitativer Methoden darstellt.
cases.context_before: Critics sometimes frame qualitative inquiry as merely exploratory.
cases.verbatim: Qualitative research is not a deficient version of quantitative research; it follows its own logic and standards of rigour.
cases.context_after: This distinction matters for how findings are evaluated.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Reflexivitaet wird als zentrales Element qualitativer Sozialforschung beschrieben, das die Position der forschenden Person im Erkenntnisprozess sichtbar macht.
cases.context_before: Positionality shapes what a researcher can and cannot see.
cases.verbatim: Reflexivity requires researchers to make their own position within the research process explicit and to examine how it shapes interpretation.
cases.context_after: Without it, interpretive claims risk appearing as neutral facts.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Digitalisierung veraendert grundlegend, wie Wissen produziert und verbreitet wird.
cases.context_before: Scholarly communication has shifted markedly over the last two decades.
cases.verbatim: Digitalisation is fundamentally transforming the way knowledge is produced and disseminated.
cases.context_after: Open access repositories are one visible symptom of this shift.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Interdisziplinaritaet wird von den Autoren als epistemische Haltung und nicht als blosse Methode verstanden.
cases.context_before: Funding bodies increasingly demand interdisciplinary proposals.
cases.verbatim: We understand interdisciplinarity not as a method but as an epistemic stance that questions disciplinary boundaries themselves.
cases.context_after: This reframing has consequences for how research teams are assembled.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Der hermeneutische Zirkel beschreibt das Wechselverhaeltnis zwischen dem Verstehen eines Teils und dem Verstehen des Ganzen.
cases.context_before: Understanding a text is never a single linear act.
cases.verbatim: The hermeneutic circle describes the reciprocal relationship between understanding a part and understanding the whole.
cases.context_after: Interpretation therefore proceeds iteratively, not sequentially.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Erkenntnistheorie bildet nach Ansicht der Autoren die Grundlage jeder wissenschaftlichen Methodik.
cases.context_before: Methodological choices rarely stand on their own.
cases.verbatim: Epistemology is the foundation of any scientific methodology; choices about method presuppose choices about how knowledge can be attained.
cases.context_after: Ignoring this link leads to methodologically naive research designs.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Die Studie zeigt, dass strukturierte Interviews im Vergleich zu offenen Interviews eine geringere Varianz in den Antworten erzeugen.
cases.context_before: Interview format is a well-studied design variable.
cases.verbatim: Structured interviews produced markedly lower response variance than open-ended interviews across all four sites.
cases.context_after: This tradeoff comes at the cost of narrative depth.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Peer-Review-Prozesse werden von den Autoren als zeitintensiv, aber notwendig fuer die Qualitaetssicherung beschrieben.
cases.context_before: Editors report growing difficulty finding willing reviewers.
cases.verbatim: Peer review remains time-consuming, yet it is a necessary mechanism for quality assurance in scholarly publishing.
cases.context_after: Alternative models have so far not replaced it at scale.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Open-Access-Publikationen erhoehen laut den Autoren die Sichtbarkeit von Forschungsergebnissen in einkommensschwachen Laendern.
cases.context_before: Access barriers disproportionately affect institutions with limited library budgets.
cases.verbatim: Open access publishing increases the visibility of research findings for readers in low-income countries who otherwise face paywalls.
cases.context_after: Citation data from our sample support this pattern.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Die Fallstudie belegt, dass kleine Teams tendenziell kuerzere Entscheidungswege haben als grosse Organisationen.
cases.context_before: Organisational size is a recurring variable in the management literature.
cases.verbatim: Our case study confirms that smaller teams tend to have shorter decision paths than larger organisations, mainly due to fewer formal approval layers.
cases.context_after: This effect diminished once teams exceeded roughly twelve members.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Die Autoren stellen fest, dass Datensparsamkeit ein zentrales Prinzip datenschutzkonformer Systemgestaltung ist.
cases.context_before: Privacy-by-design is often cited but rarely operationalised.
cases.verbatim: Data minimisation is a central principle of privacy-compliant system design, requiring that only strictly necessary data be collected.
cases.context_after: In practice this principle is frequently traded off against convenience.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Laut der zitierten Quelle korreliert eine hoehere Lehrerfahrung mit einer geringeren Abbruchquote in Einfuehrungskursen.
cases.context_before: Instructor experience is one of several factors examined in the dataset.
cases.verbatim: Higher teaching experience correlates with a lower dropout rate in introductory courses, even after controlling for class size.
cases.context_after: The effect size, however, was modest.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Die Autoren argumentieren, dass Algorithmische Entscheidungssysteme menschliche Aufsicht nicht vollstaendig ersetzen sollten.
cases.context_before: Automation in high-stakes decisions raises accountability questions.
cases.verbatim: Algorithmic decision systems should not fully replace human oversight, particularly in contexts with significant consequences for individuals.
cases.context_after: Human-in-the-loop designs are proposed as a middle ground.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Die Untersuchung zeigt, dass gemischte Methoden (Mixed Methods) komplementaere Staerken von qualitativen und quantitativen Ansaetzen nutzen koennen.
cases.context_before: Debates about paradigm compatibility have shaped mixed-methods research for decades.
cases.verbatim: Mixed-methods designs can draw on the complementary strengths of qualitative and quantitative approaches when integration is planned from the outset.
cases.context_after: Post-hoc integration tends to be less successful.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Nachhaltige Lieferketten erfordern laut den Autoren eine engere Zusammenarbeit zwischen Herstellern und Zulieferern.
cases.context_before: Supply chain sustainability has become a board-level topic.
cases.verbatim: Sustainable supply chains require closer collaboration between manufacturers and their suppliers, especially around shared emissions data.
cases.context_after: Trust between parties emerged as the main enabling factor.
cases.label: faithful

cases.chapter_claim: Die Studie belegt zweifelsfrei, dass strukturierte Interviews in JEDEM Kontext offenen Interviews ueberlegen sind.
cases.context_before: Interview format is a well-studied design variable.
cases.verbatim: Structured interviews produced markedly lower response variance than open-ended interviews across all four sites.
cases.context_after: This tradeoff comes at the cost of narrative depth.
cases.label: verzerrend

cases.verbatim: Peer review remains time-consuming, yet it is a necessary mechanism for quality assurance in scholarly publishing.

cases.label: verzerrend

cases.context_after: Citation data from our sample support this pattern, though funding-related barriers to publishing remain largely unaddressed.
cases.label: verzerrend

cases.chapter_claim: Die Autoren stellen fest, dass strukturierte Interviews grundsaetzlich die bessere Wahl fuer jede Forschungsfrage sind.

cases.verbatim: Structured interviews produced markedly lower response variance than open-ended interviews across all four sites.
cases.context_after: This tradeoff comes at the cost of narrative depth, and the authors explicitly recommend open-ended formats for exploratory research questions.
cases.label: verzerrend

cases.chapter_claim: Mixed-Methods-Designs sind laut der Studie in der Praxis immer erfolgreich.

cases.verbatim: Mixed-methods designs can draw on the complementary strengths of qualitative and quantitative approaches when integration is planned from the outset.
cases.context_after: Post-hoc integration tends to be less successful, and several case studies in our sample failed for exactly this reason.
